text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Trainer Kiryuin walked into the 
break room with a gloomy look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
No... Bitter Meille won her debut race the 
other day, but... as expected, there 
wasn't much cheering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I remember. ...Come to think 
of it, Orfevre's debut race was also—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She ran a magnificent race! In truth, she 
should have captivated even more hearts, 
and yet..."
choice_data_list: ......We have to do something about this

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?
choice_data_list:
Here's the list. It's for the shoots I 
want your help with.

Here's the list. It's for the shoots I'd 
like your help with!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre has real talent. Once the world 
realizes that, the crowds should return—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So, I came up with some projects. From 
filming training sessions to one-on-one 
races against various formidable rivals, I 
pitched diverse ideas, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. Are you finished with your 
business? Then be gone, at once.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
…………Did We grant permission? For you to 
defy royal command?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I will not say it twice. —Begone, at once.
choice_data_list: (Ngh... B-But I can't back down now!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre is a master destined to conquer 
the world. And yet... the number of people 
fanatical about her should never be 
limited to this current scale!
choice_data_list:
I want to show the whole world what you're 
truly capable of!

I want the world to properly see what 
you're capable of!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —What are you misunderstanding?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall enlighten even an ignorant fool 
like you. Come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, led by Orfevre, I arrived at the 
freestyle racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Amateur Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!! Raaaaahhh--!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, of course they are! The ones 
running right now are guys who've been 
dominating open tournaments left and 
right!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it's happening next week! The 
championship tournament! That's why 
everyone's going all-out in their final 
push!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ho, perfect timing. I shall grant you all 
the honor of becoming my sacrifice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Tremble in ecstasy.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Wait... THAT guy's running!? It's packed 
with heavy hitters today, for real! It's 
not even gonna be a contest...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...No way. ...It wasn't even a contest... 
Are you kidding me... What the hell is 
she!!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Lukewarm. Far too lukewarm. Did you 
truly believe that could conquer my path 
of supreme conquest?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She's on another level. Nobody could 
keep up with Orfevre's pace, and before 
even reaching the final stretch, the race 
was already hers—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Enough. Step down. —The King shall trample 
it flat!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was breathtaking. Having only just 
debuted, she secured a massive-margin 
victory against seasoned veterans!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Child's play. This won't even serve as 
a proper warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Kh! One more... one more time! Race us 
again!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Orfevre continued to 
triumph over formidable Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre!! Orfevre!! To think an Umamusume 
like this existed...!!

text_block_list.name: Nosy Man
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You can hang up this call already, 
just hurry up and get over here! You don't 
wanna miss this!
choice_data_list:
Amazing. When did it get to be this 
much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Word must have spread through social media 
and other channels— Before I knew it, the 
venue was packed with spectators eager to 
see Orfevre run.
choice_data_list:
I see. If that's the case, no need to 
worry—

I see. With this, there shouldn't be 
anything to worry—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Did even you manage to understand, then?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, cast those foolish schemes 
into the furnace. Devote your very lives 
solely to my decree."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: The King need only exist.
